moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] is raised.
Deactivation Condition:
When the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] is not raised.

Never misses when the weather is rainy. Lowers the target’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="1" ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="2" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="2" S="rank" P="ranks" ]. Leaves the target confused. The power of this move is not lowered even if there are multiple targets. Applies the Critical-Hit Defense effect to the allied field of play.
